description:
My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this contemporary well proportioned third floor apartment situated in a new development, in the heart of Newcastle's fashionable Quayside area, with fabulous views across the river Tyne and famous bridges. The Quayside area benefits from an array of local amenities, cafes, pubs, restaurants, The Glasshouse, Baltic Centre for Contemporary Art and sunday market. There is also a short walking distance into the City Centre giving further access to many theatres, cinemas, cafes, upmarket eateries and a vibrant nightlife.

The accommodation comprises: Entrance hallway, two double bedrooms, a stylish open plan kitchen/living room with generous balcony providing enviable views over the river and a modern bathroom with shower over the bath.
